quotes: This request allows the real estate investor owning a property the purchase value of which is equal to or more than 2 million AED at the time of purchase, to apply for a 10-years renewable residence permit.
In the event that a mortgaged property, a bank letter indicating 2 million AED paid amount as a proof to be provided
1)- The value of the property is 2 million AED, wholly owned by the investor (one or more properties) under the name of the applicant

2)- The property may be mortgaged, and a no-objection bank letter to be submitted indicating that the bank does not object to issuing a residence permit on the property, indicating the paid amount and the balance
3) The applicant must be inside the UAE.
Note: Only the applicant is required to attend, escorts are not allowed to apply nor to apply by a representative is permitted.
5- Health insurance.
1- Medical examination: AED 700
2- Emirates ID (10 years): AED 1,153
3- Confirmation of residency permit (10 years): AED 2,856.75
4- Dubai Land Department fees: AED 4,020
5- Administrative fees: AED 1,155
The total is AED 9,884.75
Expected Completion Time 7 - 10 business days

Dubai World Trade Centre Central 1 - Office No. 2 Ground Floor, Office No. 21
